capabilities.description: Sync status, manual sync trigger, and the browsable PMDB list pages.
Fetches the configured PublicMetaDB lists, resolves titles through TMDB, and caches them for the browser pages.

fields.description: Your PublicMetaDB API key (publicmetadb.com → account settings). Used to read your lists.
fields.label: PublicMetaDB API Key

fields.description: One PublicMetaDB list ID per line (the ID in the list URL, e.g. pvg2vr8nuvkh2g5).
fields.label: PMDB List IDs

fields.description: TMDB API key (v3) or read access token (v4). Used for posters, metadata, and TMDB → IMDb resolution.
fields.label: TMDB API Key

fields.description: Minimum time between automatic syncs. The scheduled task skips runs inside this window; the admin page can always force a sync.
fields.label: Sync Interval (minutes)

fields.description: Where the plugin keeps its synced list cache. Defaults inside the plugin data directory.
fields.label: Cache File

global_config_schema.description: Which PublicMetaDB lists to browse and how often to refresh them.
global_config_schema.title: PMDB lists

presentation.description_markdown: Browsable pages for your PublicMetaDB lists inside Silo. A scheduled task keeps the lists cached with TMDB posters and metadata, and each title is badged with whether it is already in your Silo libraries — handy for spotting what's on the list but missing from the library. (Silo's plugin API cannot add library items, so this is a discovery view; the companion Vio plugin turns the same lists into playable virtual libraries.)
presentation.setup_markdown: Enter your PublicMetaDB API key and one list ID per line, add a TMDB API key for posters and metadata, then press Sync Now on the PMDB Lists page to run the first import.
